bio.text: Jason Anavitarte, a Republican, has served in the Georgia State Senate since 2020 and represents District 31, which includes all of Polk County and most of Paulding County; the legislature biography lists him as Senate Majority Caucus Chairman.
Anavitarte was elected to the Doraville City Council in 2003, served as mayor pro tem, and was elected to the Paulding County School Board in 2018.
Anavitarte earned an undergraduate degree from Georgia State University and an M.S. in Public Policy from the Georgia Institute of Technology, and lives in Dallas, Georgia.
